# Houssem Ben Ali

> DevOps & SecOps engineer's homepage — an interactive terminal/README linking to a set of free, open-source security and network inspection tools.

Live at https://www.hbenali.ovh. No backend, single static `index.html`.

## Tools
- [BIMI Checker](https://bimi.hbenali.ovh/): BIMI record, DMARC readiness, and VMC certificate validator.
- [CAA Checker](https://caa.hbenali.ovh/): DNS CAA record inspector and generator.
- [DNSSEC Inspector](https://dnssec.hbenali.ovh/): validates a domain's DNSSEC chain of trust and diagnoses why validation failed.
- [SSL Chain Checker](https://ssl.hbenali.ovh/): TLS certificate chain validator.
- [RDAP Inspector](https://rdap.hbenali.ovh/): domain, IP, and ASN registration lookup (RDAP).
- [IP Inspector](https://ip.hbenali.ovh/): IP geolocation, ISP/ASN, and VPN/proxy/Tor detection.
- [DKIM Checker](https://dkim.hbenali.ovh/): DKIM DNS record inspector.
- [DMARC Checker](https://dmarc.hbenali.ovh/): DMARC DNS record inspector.
- [SPF Checker](https://spf.hbenali.ovh/): SPF DNS record inspector.
- [CommitSign](https://commitsign.hbenali.ovh/): Git SSH commit signing setup scripts and guides.
- [frontail](https://frontail.hbenali.ovh/): streams log files to the browser, live demo.

## About
- [About](https://about.hbenali.ovh/): background, experience, and CV.
